name: teamLab Planets
summary: Barefoot rooms of water and light that you wade right through.
description: Barefoot, wade through knee-deep water; fixed route, shorter and tightly sequenced. Roll-up trousers needed. The young-child / easy-pace answer; timed tickets.

disclosure.text: You go barefoot here and wade through water up to knee height, so trousers roll up and bags go in a locker.

audiences.text: Because you told us you are pregnant: the water floor is smooth and there is no handrail, so tell the staff on arrival and they will walk you around the water rooms instead — you would miss two of the artworks on that path.
Knee height for you is chest height for a little one, so the water rooms are a carry — the staff will route you around them if you would rather stay dry.
The water floor is smooth and unrailed underfoot; staff can route you around the water rooms if you would rather not wade.

opening_hours.note: DELIBERATELY CONSERVATIVE. Wednesday is the market's standing day off; Sundays ALTERNATE on the Tokyo wholesale rota, which a flat weekday list cannot express, so all Sundays are excluded. This loses roughly half the Sundays it is genuinely open — chosen on purpose, because a 5 AM taxi to a shuttered tuna auction is a far worse morning. Residual public-holiday closures → K1/4B.
